projects.name: Buddy
projects.description:
A SaaS job platform (freelance) for part-time job opportunities in France, connecting verified applicants (students & individuals) with businesses.
Implemented authentication via Clerk, payments using Stripe, a clean UI with shadcn/ui, and multilingual support with next-intl. Built admin and business dashboards for verification, job management, and analytics.

projects.name: CoGlider
projects.description: CoGlider is a cross platform Mobile app designed to connect like-minded individuals by matching them based on skills and proximity. Whether you're looking for a project partner, a mentor, or just someone to collaborate with, CoGlider simplifies the process by providing intelligent recommendations and real-time communication.

projects.name: ProJet
projects.description:
A sleek platform where developers and students can upload, manage, and showcase all their personal or academic projects in one place.
It also lets users explore projects from others, encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and community-driven growth within student and tech circles.

projects.name: FileGlide
projects.description:
A no-login, no-setup file sharing tool built for speed and simplicity.
Users can instantly share files across devices using a unique code, making it ideal for classrooms, group work, or quick handoffs — no accounts, no friction, just files.
